data.exact_reserve_text: The 2014 and prior years produced a net loss of GBP 10,679k, following worse than expected claims activity, particularly in Professional Indemnity.
specific_events: Ogden discount rate change (MoJ proposals re the Ogden tables reflected at +0.25% in 2017)

prior_year_events.impact_description: Change in assumed Ogden discount rate reflected in 2017 results (assumed rate +0.25%), affecting reserves for UK personal injury claims and employer's liability inflation assumptions.

prior_year_events.event_name: Adverse claims activity in Professional Indemnity
prior_year_events.impact_description: Worse than expected claims activity in 2014 and prior years, particularly in Professional Indemnity, produced a net loss on those years.

named_events.loss_description: Reflected in 2017 results at an assumed rate of +0.25%; previously anticipated at -0.75% which impacted 2016 results.

data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2017 was GBP 1,148.563m. The claims development for prior years shows no material net movement on the net claims development table (net prior-year development ~GBP 0m), i.e. effectively flat. Narrative notes highlight adverse claims activity in 2014 and prior years (notably Professional Indemnity) and the impact of changes in the Ogden discount rate which were reflected in the 2017 result; Professional Lines experienced adverse large-loss activity, while Ogden/legal changes affected UK employer liability reserving assumptions.
raw_causal_phrases: following worse than expected claims activity, particularly in Professional Indemnity.
adverse large loss experience in the Professional Lines portfolio.
improved impact of the Ogden table changes, including claims inflation assumptions on UK Employer's Liability reserves, coupled with reduced in year reinsurance spend and improved net claims ratio.
data.data_quality_notes: No explicit GROSS prior-year reserve movement (movement in prior year's provision) was stated in the notes. A net claims development (cumulative claims triangle) is available but only on a NET basis; using the net claims development triangle yields net prior-year development of approximately GBP 0m (flat). Therefore prior_year_development_gbp_m is reported as 0.0 based on the NET triangle fallback. Gross PYD not available in the disclosures.
